description: The line plot illustrates the loss ratio (%) of different LLM configurations as a function of TFLOPs (tera floating-point operations), comparing “Vanilla” LLM performance against several variants of SepLLM under varying hyperparameters. The x-axis, labeled “TFLOPs,” spans from 1e7 to 9e8 on a logarithmic scale, with major tick marks at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis, labeled “Loss Ratio (%)”, ranges from 94% to 100% on a linear scale, with tick marks at 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, and 100. Five distinct lines are plotted: “Vanilla” (purple triangles, solid line) remains nearly flat at 100% across all TFLOPs; “SepLLM (n=64)” (orange squares, solid line) starts at ~98.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to ~100.2% at 4e8, then slightly declines to ~99.8% at 9e8; “SepLLM (n=128)” (blue crosses, solid line) begins at ~97.0% at 1e7, climbs to ~99.8% at 3e8, and stabilizes near 99.8–100% thereafter; “SepLLM (n=64, H)” (green diamonds, solid line) starts at ~97.5% at 1e7, increases to ~100% by 3e8, and fluctuates slightly around 100% up to 9e8; “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” (red circles, solid line) begins at ~94.2% at 1e7, rises steeply to ~98.2% at 5e7, continues climbing to ~99.2% at 3e8, peaks at ~99.1% at 4e8, dips to ~98.5% at 5e8, then stabilizes around 98.7–98.9% through 9e8. All lines show improvement in loss ratio with increasing TFLOPs, though “Vanilla” remains consistently at 100%, indicating no loss reduction, while the SepLLM variants show varying degrees of improvement depending on their configuration.
